text_block_list.name: Voice of Destiny
text_block_list.text:
(Win! WIN!!!!
――You have to win, no matter what!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooo-OOOOOOOH
         O   o  o OOOOooO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't believe the sight before my eyes.
Epiphaneia had completely lost her composure,
and was simply—wildly exploding with emotion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Before I knew it, all I was doing was praying. Not for victory, but first and foremost, for her safety...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haa...!
Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—I lost?
Why?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Even after I...!!
Followed the voice of destiny...!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaah...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Epi's really rowdy today...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey... even so, that running style...
It's amazing, but... maybe a little scary too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It feels... different.
She's not... Epi-san.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Because... it's not like I want
to run like that...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I...
What was I...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I was completely useless.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Before the race, the voice of destiny... cried out, 'Win!' to me—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, thank you.
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"But why?!
The voice of destiny has always just pushed me forward, so why now...?"
choice_data_list: It was like... it was swallowing you whole...
It was like it was swallowing you whole...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"That's right...!
She ran in front of me—and pulled me along!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Why?
Why does the 'Voice of Fate' provoke me like this!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Is that really... the right way after all?
But that goes against what you believe in.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In fact, nobody felt that sense of destiny today!
...Even though it was the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Even though it was... the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I want to believe. In both the voice of destiny and in you.
I want to believe in both!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her so confused right now,
saying too much would be counterproductive.
Getting her to calm down comes first.
choice_data_list: ...Could you give me a little time?
...Could you give me a little bit of time?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Time?
choice_data_list: At the Kikuka Sho, I will definitely guide you to the best possible result.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After this comes the summer training camp, where the Umamusume work to hone their skills. During that time, I can help untangle the confusion she's currently trapped in—
choice_data_list: —I'll guide you to the future you desire.
—Because I will guide you to the future you desire.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will await your decision!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, I believe in you!
Because you're my destiny."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once Epiphaneia calms down and returns to the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Good work.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Kris S!
You came to watch?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: But, I...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —You just need to deliver results moving forward. If it's you... you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Do your best next time too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whenever I'm alone, regret grips my chest tight. How I ran today—it's entirely my own fault.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Understood!
I shall follow your lead!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—I was too naive, there's no denying it.
There must have been so much more I could have done."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I tried everything, yet I failed...
If I am to move forward from here, I must be flawlessly, death-defyingly prepared."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Late at night, I gaze at the document I've just written.
It was a letter of resignation.
If I couldn't lead her to victory in the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I fold it up small so I can carry it with me anywhere.
It's not something to run away with, but a proof of my resolve to guide her to where she wants to be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So that I don't lose Epiphaneia, and to give her the future that her incredible talent deserves—this time, I will answer her trust.
